assumptions.statement: Exact statutory controls, FAR, height, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, investment, approval paths and commitments are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No precision-sensitive move or replacement action is asserted; all intensity/massing rules are conceptual.
assumptions.closure: Replace with official controls and rights-holder/professional confirmation, then recompute all dependent layers and metrics.

assumptions.statement: Organizer data provides a rough 11.4 km² envelope and three placeholder rectangles, not exact official polygons.
assumptions.impact: Areas are consistency calculations only; all layers, metrics and figures require full recomputation.
assumptions.closure: Obtain official polygons and rebuild topology/metrics/graphics as one change set.

assumptions.statement: The provisional south key-area rectangle is materially displaced from the contextual Dazhongsi station anchor.
assumptions.impact: South work remains a typological grade-separated station-city field, never a parcel or station-corner plan; four-quadrant connectivity is structured as a conceptual design organization around verified station access (Line 13 Exits A/B, Line 12 Exits D/E) and contextual street interfaces.
assumptions.closure: Reconcile provisional geometry with verified station access (Line 13 Exits A/B, Line 12 Exits D/E) and official key-area polygons before detailed design delivery.

assumptions.statement: Building use, condition, structure, fire safety, heritage status, title, occupancy, adaptability and relocation effects are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No existing building is diagnosed as vacant, low-efficiency, safe, reusable, openable or demolishable; polygons are prototypes only.
assumptions.closure: Complete professional building/user/rights survey with documented consent.

assumptions.statement: Parcel ownership, tenure, public-rights status and operator consents are not supplied.
assumptions.impact: Public/public-side rooms and all adaptive actions remain conditional; no property action or public access is claimed.
assumptions.closure: Confirm rights, tenure, operating agreement and public-interest process.

assumptions.statement: Campus entry, station exits, crossings, step-free continuity and public opening hours are incomplete and may change.
assumptions.impact: Permanent public routes stay outside campuses; exact entrances/catchments are not claimed.
assumptions.closure: Run current field access audit and obtain operator/institution confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Road hierarchy, curb use, cycling facilities, pickup/dropoff, loading, waste and emergency operations are not verified.
assumptions.impact: Connections are labelled by confidence and never presented as redlines, approved bridges/tunnels or capacity conclusions.
assumptions.closure: Survey and coordinate with transport/street/emergency operators.

assumptions.statement: Electricity, communications, compute, water, drainage, waste, fire/life-safety and maintenance capacities are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No capacity or infrastructure-megaproject claim; existing eligible services are used first.
assumptions.closure: Obtain records, engineering surveys, operator approval and life-cycle/exit plan.

assumptions.statement: Trees, root zones, soil, drainage, hydrology, habitat, heat, night light/noise and seasonal conditions are unknown at design-patch scale.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green polygons are conceptual response areas, not surveyed ecology or water engineering.
assumptions.closure: Carry out tree/soil/water/maintenance/noise/lighting survey before design delivery.

assumptions.statement: Delivery, maintenance, waste, event, worker, business and residential conflicts are not established at site level.
assumptions.impact: Servicing is an audit layer with timed states, not an asserted hidden network.
assumptions.closure: Complete timed observation and user/operator co-design.

assumptions.statement: No named organization, carrier, model, dataset, operator or partnership is committed to the three bounded AI task packets.
assumptions.impact: AI spaces are reversible typologies with NO-BUILD outcomes, not promised facilities or endorsements.
assumptions.closure: Confirm task owner, authorization, minimum resource, qualified review, carrier and exit agreement.

assumptions.statement: The taskbook establishes a concept boundary but does not appoint a local operator, reviewer, safety lead, owner, approval body or legal stop authority for any scenario.
assumptions.impact: Role names in the proposal are proposed operational role types; they are not statutory facts or appointments.
assumptions.closure: Confirm rights-holder, operator and statutory/professional responsibilities before any field-facing activity.

assumptions.statement: No budget, grant, investor, procurement route, public-funding promise or cost approval is provided for the proposed operational cycle or spatial deltas.
assumptions.impact: The proposal presents only conditional funding mechanism options and removes delivery cost claims.
assumptions.closure: Confirm an authorized budget path and the responsible rights-holder/operator before procurement or delivery.

assumptions.statement: The package is ready for concept discussion and offline review only. The participant-readiness dossier is a reference handoff method, not field data, access, authorization, capacity, safety, budget, operator, commissioning or professional confirmation.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is described as deployed, field-validated, engineering-feasible or ready to operate; the dossier preserves a carrier screen/reject path, role-type handoff, NO-GO, acceptance, rights, and Day-1/Week-1 HOLD closure structure.
assumptions.closure: Complete applicable survey, rights/access agreement, authorized role assignment, professional review, field observation and supervised rehearsal before considering a field test.

assumptions.statement: The 12 m x 9 m zero-coordinate S01 P0 envelope, its role positions, components and session cap are a participant-authored conceptual reference only.
assumptions.impact: It does not establish a site, carrier, clearance, egress, loading, anchorage, utility capacity, code compliance, approved operation, cost, budget or field performance.
assumptions.closure: A future rights-holder, qualified professionals and field observation must independently confirm carrier, access, safety, accessibility, capacity, roles, stop/reset rehearsal and ordinary-baseline restoration before any physical test is considered.
